comment_regular: Oblivion 3-component position/vector key-track evaluator. One key or sentinel time returns key value at +4. Otherwise cursor-assisted bracket search uses the supplied byte stride, normalized segment time selects the interpolation-type dispatch table, and the lower-key cursor is written back.
